description: This file defines the internal sealed class `ConsistentRingProvider` implementing `IConsistentRingProvider`, `ISiloStatusListener`, and `IDisposable`, which manages a ring of silo nodes, responsible for assigning responsibilities to nodes in a distributed system using consistent hashing. It includes methods for adding/removing servers, computing the primary target silo for a key, handling silo status changes, and notifying listeners of range changes. The class emphasizes maintaining a consistent view of the ring, handling node membership updates, and managing responsibility assignments.

classes.name: ConsistentRingProvider
classes.description: Manages a consistent hash ring of silo nodes for responsibility distribution in a distributed system, handling silo membership, range calculations, and notifications.

methods.name: GetPrimaryTargetSilo
methods.description: Returns the primary silo responsible for the given key based on the ring's hash responsibilities.

methods.name: GetMyRange
methods.description: Retrieves the current hash range assigned to this silo.

methods.name: SubscribeToRangeChangeEvents
methods.description: Registers an observer for range change notifications.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromRangeChangeEvents
methods.description: Unregisters an observer from range change notifications.

methods.name: SiloStatusChangeNotification
methods.description: Updates ring membership or responsibilities based on changes in silo status.
